metadata.explanation: Ambulance route: Nodes [0, 1, 2, 5] across 3 directed links (150m each). At 1.5x speed multiplier (18.75 m/s), free-flow travel time is 8.0s per link, or 24.0s total. The ambulance is dispatched inside the simulation loop at tick 120 after traffic queues have stabilized. ambulance_time_sec measures elapsed time from entry at tick 120 until arrival at destination. Preemption flushes queues ahead and commands green signals, approaching free-flow travel time.
